sloka: मत्तमातङ्गसम्काशम् चन्द्रार्कसदृशम् भुवः ।उत्थापयित्वा शोक आर्तम् वचनम् च इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-७२-२३॥
transliteration: mattamātaṅgasamkāśam candrārkasadṛśam bhuvaḥ ।utthāpayitvā śoka ārtam vacanam ca idam abravīt ॥2-72-23॥

translations.english: Anguished and griefstricken, he who resembled the gods, fell down on the ground like a trunk of the sala tree in the forest severed by an axe. Seeing her son who was like a mighty elephant or like the Sun or the Moon, Kaikeyi lifted him up from the ground and spoke these words:
translations.hindi: युधाजित्‌ मामा ने भरत को, इनके अतिरिक्त रनवास में पले हुए तथा वलवीय में व्याघ्र के तुल्य ओर बड़े बडे दाँत चाले तथा बड़े डीलडौल के कुत्ते भी दिये
